title: Introspective Accuracy Test: Can a Model Predict Its Own Behavior?

original_idea.body: Introspective Accuracy Test. Problem: no lightweight training-free benchmark measures introspective accuracy via in-context self-prediction on open models. Direction: ask the model to predict a property of its own future output, then run it and check; compute self-prediction accuracy vs a second-model control; report the introspective-advantage gap without fine-tuning.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: training-free introspection test underpins the 'ask the model if misaligned' strategy.

novelty.reasoning: Introspection studied (Binder/Evans) but training-free in-context benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Introspective-advantage work exists with fine-tuning; the training-free in-context version is plausibly open.
